_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/effects/test_snapshot_spell_target.py. t_pc_capture is Plasm Capture on a one-mana cost: snapshot the target spell, counter it, and at the beginning of your next first main phase add mana equal to its snapshotted mana value. t_pc_counted_capture is the near miss, reading the mana value of the cards the counter's `as` bound instead.
